aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To exact personal revenge, a man embraces the dark art of shamanism, triggering a series of terrifying events that alter his life forever.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Driven by an overwhelming desire for vengeance, a man makes the fateful decision to inherit the mysterious and dangerous art of shamanism. As he delves deeper into the spirit world to execute his plan, he unknowingly unleashes sinister forces far beyond his control. The resulting sequence of horrifying encounters forces him to confront the dark consequences of his choices, irrevocably shattering his life.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Consuming thoughts of personal retribution drive a man to seek out the ancient, ritualistic practice of shamanism to punish those who wronged him. Ignoring the severe warnings associated with meddling in supernatural forces, he undergoes a arduous initiation to become a full-fledged shaman. Armed with newly acquired spiritual capabilities, he initiates a dangerous path of revenge using occult rituals. However, bridging the gap between the living and the spirit world demands a heavy toll and attracts malevolent entities. As dark spirits begin to manifest, the line between his desire for justice and horrific chaos rapidly blurs. Unintended victims are caught in the crossfire of his supernatural vendetta as terrifying events escalate out of hand. Psychological strain and gruesome encounters test the limits of his sanity while the spirits demand their own price. Ultimately, his pursuit of vengeance leads to an irreversible transformation, leaving his original life completely destroyed.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Confessions of a Shaman is an intense horror-thriller that explores the dark intersection of grief, vengeance, and supernatural occultism. The narrative follows an ordinary man who, consumed by a burning need for personal revenge, chooses to take up the ancient legacy of shamanism to gain power over his enemies. As he immerses himself in rituals designed to bridge the realm of the living and the spirits, he opens the door to terrifying supernatural forces. The story delves into the severe emotional and spiritual consequences of wielding dark arts for selfish ends, delivering a tense atmosphere filled with horror, suspense, and dramatic stakes.

story_structure.climax: The vengeful forces he unleashed reach a terrifying breaking point, forcing a desperate confrontation with the malevolent consequences of his actions.

story_structure.resolution: With his life permanently transformed by the ordeal, he is left to face the irreversible price of pursuing vengeance through forbidden arts.
story_structure.introduction: A man living an ordinary life is drawn into the dark, ancestral world of shamanism, making the fateful choice to accept the mantle.
story_structure.risingAction: As he performs increasingly hazardous rituals, horrifying and uncontrollable events begin to escalate, blurring the line between perpetrator and victim.
